acceptanceCriteria: A1: WI-211 is linked to this explicit successor recovery without rewriting its immutable archive, evidence, or Outcome.
A2: finalize-plan is bound to PR #160 before successor verification and the pre-merge finalization receipt is valid and deterministic.
A3: repository governance gates pass with WI-211 recovered and this successor awaiting merge close.
A4: the successor closes only after hosted PR merge, finalize-verify, exact cleanup, and a visible human Outcome.
goal: 根治 Work Item 在资源收尾计划之前归档后无法生成有效 pre-merge finalization receipt 的流程缺口。
intent: 恢复 WI-211 在 finalize-plan 前归档造成的不可闭合发布治理边界，并在当前 PR 上建立正确的资源上下文与收尾顺序。
outOfScope: Moving or rewriting immutable v0.2.26 history

scenarioCoverage.expected: WI-211 remains byte-identical and is classified as recovered through an explicit successor receipt.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Record a Runtime recovery receipt binding WI-211 and this successor, then run the governance gate.

scenarioCoverage.expected: PR #160 context is bound before successor verification and a blocked pre-merge receipt is valid.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run finalize-plan before verification, then record an awaiting-merge-close finalization receipt.

scenarioCoverage.expected: After PR merge, finalize-verify and structured close bind the merged head and exact cleanup.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run hosted checks, merge PR #160, synchronize main, finalize, finalize-verify, and close.
